rootCause: Final external closure documents changed after the evidence package receipts were generated. Embedding receipts for closure documents that themselves bind the evidence ZIP creates an avoidable circular evidence dependency.
correctionLaw: Final validation/handoff are external closure documents. The corrected evidence ZIP contains no receipt for those external documents. After the corrected evidence ZIP is finalized, Controller-corrected external validation/handoff bind its exact SHA and receive external companion SHA receipts.
